name: MITRE Cyber Wargaming Framework
description: MITRE Corporation's structured methodology and framework for designing and conducting cyber wargames for organizations of all sizes. Provides guidance on scenario development, participant roles, facilitation, and after-action review for exploring complex cyber threat landscapes, testing strategic cyber policies, and training cyber incident response teams under realistic adversarial conditions.
reputation: Authoritative practitioner framework from a leading U.S. federally-funded research and development center
notes: Published as an open-access technical report. Widely referenced in government and defense cyber exercise planning. Integrates with MITRE ATT&CK framework for threat modeling.
